headline: Novosense Plans RMB 486.9 Million Acquisition of AirTouch Stake
summary: Novosense Microelectronics announced plans to acquire a 78.15% stake in Ningbo AirTouch Intelligent Technology for RMB 486.93 million in cash to expand its RF and ADAS operations.
why: Novosense Microelectronics is a Chinese supplier of analog integrated circuits listed in Shanghai and Hong Kong.

entities.name: Ningbo Airtouch Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.

impacts.name: NOVOSENSE Microelectronics
impacts.why: Novosense uses cash reserves to expand its semiconductor product line into automotive and smart terminal markets.
